name: Exp_JFatlCandle_MMRec
summary: This EA trades based on JFATL (Jurik Fast Adaptive Trend Line) candle color changes, entering long when the JFATL candle turns bullish and short when it turns bearish. It incorporates money management recommendations (MMRec) for dynamic position sizing based on account equity and risk parameters, and includes trailing stop functionality for trade management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于JFATL（Jurik快速自适应趋势线）K线颜色变化进行交易，当JFATL K线转为看涨时做多，转为看跌时做空。它集成了资金管理推荐模块（MMRec），根据账户权益和风险参数动态计算仓位，并包含追踪止损功能进行持仓管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于JFATL指标的趋势跟踪系统。JFATL是Jurik系列指标中的快速自适应趋势线，通过对价格数据进行平滑处理来识别趋势方向，其K线颜色变化作为趋势反转的信号。入场条件为：当JFATL K线由跌转涨（颜色从红变绿）时开多单，由涨转跌（颜色从绿变红）时开空单。出场条件包括追踪止损触发和反向信号出现时的平仓。仓位管理采用MMRec模块，根据账户净值、风险百分比和止损距离动态计算每笔交易的手数。资金管理方面支持固定手数和风险比例手数两种模式，并设有最大持仓限制和反向信号时平仓再开仓的选项。整体策略逻辑清晰，但完全依赖单一指标信号，缺乏多维度确认。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a trend following system based on the JFATL indicator. JFATL is the Fast Adaptive Trend Line from the Jurik indicator series, which identifies trend direction by smoothing price data, with its candle color changes serving as trend reversal signals. Entry conditions are: open long when the JFATL candle changes from bearish to bullish (color changes from red to green), and open short when it changes from bullish to bearish (green to red). Exit conditions include trailing stop activation and position closure upon opposing signal generation. Position sizing uses the MMRec module, which dynamically calculates lot size based on account equity, risk percentage, and stop-loss distance. Money management supports both fixed lot and risk-proportional lot sizing modes, with maximum position limits and an option to close and reverse on opposing signals. The overall strategy logic is clear but relies entirely on a single indicator signal without multi-dimensional confirmation.

parameters.name: MoneyRisk
parameters.description: 每笔交易的风险比例，用于动态计算仓位
parameters.description_en: Risk fraction per trade for dynamic lot calculation

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设固定止损

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设固定止盈

parameters.name: ReverseSignal
parameters.description: 是否在反向信号时平仓并开反向仓
parameters.description_en: Close and reverse position on opposite signal

parameters.name: MM_Type
parameters.description: 资金管理类型：1=固定手数，2=风险比例手数

pros: 采用Jurik系列JFATL指标，信号平滑性好，能有效减少市场噪音带来的虚假信号
集成MMRec资金管理模块，支持根据风险比例动态调整仓位，有利于长期资金曲线稳定
提供追踪止损功能，可以在趋势行情中锁定浮盈，同时让利润充分奔跑
支持反向信号平仓再开仓机制，能快速响应趋势反转，减少回撤
pros_en: Uses the Jurik JFATL indicator which provides excellent signal smoothing and effectively reduces false signals from market noise
Integrates the MMRec money management module supporting dynamic position sizing based on risk percentage, promoting long-term equity curve stability
Provides trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits during trending markets while allowing profits to run
Supports close-and-reverse on opposing signals, enabling quick response to trend reversals and reducing drawdowns
cons: 完全依赖单一JFATL指标信号，缺乏多维度确认，在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
默认止损和止盈均为0，如果不手动设置追踪止损，交易将没有明确的退出机制，风险极高
JFATL指标参数固定，不能根据不同品种和市场环境自适应调整，可能导致在某些品种上表现不佳
缺乏传播过滤和时段过滤机制，在低流动性时段交易可能遭遇滑点和点差扩大问题
cons_en: Relies entirely on a single JFATL indicator signal without multi-dimensional confirmation, prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Default stop-loss and take-profit are both zero, meaning trades have no explicit exit mechanism unless trailing stop is manually configured, posing extreme risk
JFATL indicator parameters are fixed and cannot adapt to different instruments and market conditions, potentially leading to poor performance on some symbols
Lacks spread filter and session filter mechanisms, which may result in trading during low-liquidity periods suffering from slippage and widened spreads
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，如要求高周期JFATL方向一致时才入场，可大幅减少震荡市中的虚假信号
增加传播过滤和交易时段限制，避免在点差过大或流动性不足的时段开仓
增加震荡/趋势市场自适应识别模块，在震荡行情中降低仓位或暂停交易
为默认参数添加合理的止损值，避免用户未配置时出现无止损的危险交易
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation requiring higher timeframe JFATL direction alignment before entry, which could significantly reduce false signals in ranging markets
Add spread filter and trading session restrictions to avoid opening positions during periods of excessive spread or insufficient liquidity
Add a ranging/trending market adaptive identification module to reduce position size or pause trading during ranging conditions
Set reasonable default stop-loss values to prevent dangerous no-stop-loss trades when users fail to configure parameters

risk_points: 默认止损和止盈均为0，若未配置追踪止损则交易无退出机制，存在巨大亏损风险
单一指标依赖在震荡市中容易产生连续亏损信号，缺乏震荡行情识别和保护机制
没有传播过滤和交易时段控制，可能在恶劣交易条件下开仓
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit of zero means no exit mechanism if trailing stop is not configured, creating enormous loss potential
Single indicator dependency generates consecutive losing signals in ranging markets without ranging market detection and protection
No spread filter or session control may result in opening positions under adverse trading conditions
